name: @gnosia/studio
//: The diagram studio's job runner and its loopback HTTP API. A separate process rather than a route inside the Next app, because a queue inside a dev server dies on every hot reload and loopback-only binding is a stronger boundary than any same-origin guard. See docs/TLDRAWKC-INTEGRATION.md, D10.
//dependencies: The schema package, only for the two state machines and the shared path constants: a second copy of JOB_TRANSITIONS would be a second state machine. The content package, for the reader seam the topic vocabulary comes through (docs/CONTENT-MIGRATION.md 0.6), which replaced this service's own YAML parser. The catalog is reached through its CLI for everything but one read: the BYOK harness opens the owner's sealed provider keys itself (docs/BYOK.md, D12), through the catalog's ./state export and the tutor's server/provider-keys, which is why those two are dependencies here. The blob package, to stream a diagram's SVG out of the store the catalog wrote it to (Track D), by the key the catalog lists.
//devDependencies: ignore is the gitignore matcher the claude CLI checks Read and Edit path rules with. The settings test runs the sibling-job globs through it, since a glob that matches this job's own workspace would silently take its candidate away.
